# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait canvas platform runner called Starcap Sprint. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: the hero auto-runs, can jump only while grounded, lands by platform-top collision, collects coin arcs for 10 points each, advances a world/trail label by score, fails on central hazard strips or falling, and restarts with a full reset. Transform the presentation into a cheerful mushroom-kingdom-inspired arcade adventure starring Pip, a red-capped courier with a star badge. Use bright sky, cap hills, grassy brick platforms, secret cap blocks, star coins, toothy chomp patches, readable HUD chips, large touch-friendly CTAs, and catalog-approved arcade fonts/audio. Do not add new mechanics or alter scoring, physics, progression, or input semantics.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first side-view endless platform runner on a canvas.
- objective: keep the red-capped runner alive, land on generated platforms, collect coins worth 10 points, and advance the world label by score.
- input model: tap/click playfield, Space, or ArrowUp triggers a jump; jump only succeeds while grounded; start/restart buttons use native click/tap.
- core loop: auto-run horizontally, gravity pulls the hero down, platforms scroll through a camera offset, coins are collected by radius overlap, and new platform chunks generate ahead.
- fail/friction state: landing on the middle hazard strip of a marked platform or falling below the playfield triggers game over and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Constant auto-run speed, gravity value, jump force, and one grounded jump at a time.
- Platform landing collision using previous-bottom crossing against platform top.
- Procedural platform generation cadence, gaps, random heights, hazards, secret flags, and coin arcs.
- Score increments of 10 per collected coin and world/progression label derived from score thresholds.
- Fail semantics for hazard strips and falling; restart resets score, camera, hero, platforms, coins, and particles.
- Mobile tap lifecycle: buttons must remain clickable, playfield taps trigger jumps only during active play.

## Remixed target
Starcap Sprint keeps the exact runner-platformer loop but reframes it as a cheerful mushroom-kingdom-inspired portrait adventure. Pip, a red-capped courier, sprints through cap hills, bonks secret cap blocks, gathers star coins, and avoids toothy chomp patches. Presentation changes target HUD vocabulary, start/game-over copy, cap/star focal identity, procedural enemy form, background meaning, and mobile readability without changing gameplay rules.
